title: Normative DWI
description: Voxelwise normative z-score maps for DTI and NODDI maps in UK Biobank 2 mm space, against PCNtoolkit models of the UK Biobank population.

zmap.title: Normative z-maps
zmap.description: Score each map against the voxel models for its marker (named in the file name: FA, MD, ICVF, ISOVF or OD) given the subject's age and sex.

maps.description: Harmonised FA, MD, ICVF, ISOVF or OD maps on the UK Biobank 2 mm grid

compute.description: CPU (double precision, the reference) or GPU (WebGPU, single precision; falls back to CPU)

storeUrl.description: URL of an nmzarr model store served with HTTP range requests and CORS (required until a default store is published)
